book.name: Macho
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Macho gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Muh wù kuge antɛnɛɛ a bvunfoŋ bvù fɛwe
Kife kiyu le, booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo biih wu le lɛ, “Muh wù kuge wu fede muh wuchii antɛnɛɛ a bvunfoŋ bvù fɛwe le, le wù la?”
Jiso mo wu tɛɛŋ mwa wu shige wu leesɛ a bo ntɛnɛɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, bɛŋ baaŋ kusɛ gɛ bɛŋ tu njɛ booŋ ba shige shige gɛ, tu gɛ bɛŋ nyu bɛŋ to bɛŋ lee fɛ bvunfoŋ bvù fɛwe le gɛ.
Nɛ le yɛɛŋ wu le wu jo kikwɛɛ ke fɛkuu wu tu njɛ mwa wunɛ, tu wu le muh wù kuge antɛnɛɛ a bvunfoŋ bvù fɛwe
Nɛ muh fii mwa njɛ wunɛ a jee chaŋ le, tu wu fii nyume mɛ.

Geenɛ, kɛnɛ nyume yɛɛŋ wù ge mwa wù shige wù lese fitele ye yaŋ le, wu ge kimbefɛ, fi joŋe fɛ wuwɛɛ muh le lɛ ba shɛŋshɛ kibwee ki jɛnɛ a kindoŋ ke le, ba tooŋsɛ wu wu shii wu gɛɛŋ a joo yì baaŋ le.
Ŋgɛ wù baaŋ le fɛ bamii ba yi woŋ kfunɛ le. Mwɛɛ mù tele bamii fɛ bo gee bimbefɛ kɛme gɛh ki mu nyûme yu. Geenɛ, ŋgɛ wù baaŋ le fɛ muh wù too bɛ mu le.

Nɛ kibo kuŋ kɛnɛ kikaa kuŋ gee wo gee kimbefɛ, wo suunɛ kibo kiyu kɛnɛ kikaa kiyu wo noŋ. Fi joŋe lɛ wo ge wo lee kinche kì kage gɛ le bɛ kibo kɛnɛ kikaa kiŋkfunɛ, fede ki wo kɛ̂me chiaaŋ yichii kɛnɛ bikaa bichii ba to ba jo wo ba noŋ yi ŋgu wù kage gɛ le.
Nɛ jise chuŋ gêe wo gee kimbefɛ, wo bvûsɛ jise chiyu wo noŋ. Fi joŋe lɛ wo lee kinche kì kage gɛ le bɛ jise chimimia, fede ki wo kɛ̂me ajii achii, ba noŋ wo ŋgu wù baaŋ le.”

content: Ŋgaŋ kune shoŋ yì gɛ̀ lɛsɛ

content.text: “Bɛŋ yɛ̂ne lɛ keefɛ bɛŋ jôde booŋ ba shige shige banɛ fɛkuu gɛ. Nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ fɛwe banchɛndaa ba Nyo ba shee bɛ bo, bo nyu segechii fwe a Chii wu fɛwe le.
[Muh wù jee che le Mwamuh gɛ̀ to ki wu bvûsɛ bamii ba lɛsɛ wa.]
Bɛŋ kwaji lɛ la? Nɛ muh kɛme shóŋ gwii, yimimia nɛ le yi lɛsɛ a yi ntɛnɛɛ, wu gɛ ya wu chinɛ yi mbaŋbvuugɛ ncho bvuugɛ le, mbegɛ le, wu gɛɛŋ wu gooŋ shoŋ yi yimimia yì lɛsɛ yɛɛ sɛŋ gɛ?
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, nɛ wu le wu gooŋ wu yɛŋ, wu yuge njoŋ bɛ shoŋ yi yimimia yɛɛ fede yi mbaŋbvuugɛ ncho bvuugɛ yì be baaŋ lɛsɛ gɛ.
Le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ tɛ no Chijaŋ wù le fɛwe goone gɛ lɛ muh wu mumwaa ŋgoo yi booŋ ba shige shige banɛ le wu lɛsɛ gɛ.

content: No taŋlo muh najɛ mwɛɛ bɛ mwa bwee

content.text: Nɛ mwa bwoo le wu ge fiɛɛ fì befe fɛ wo le, wo gɛɛŋ wo yɛŋ wu le wo dunyɛ jialɛ che wu le gɛh bena wu bafɛɛ. Wu nɛ le wu yu fiɛɛ fì wo jɛme, tu wo le wo kaasɛ wa wo kɛme mwa bwoo jiŋ.
Wu nɛ baaŋ yu gɛ fiɛɛ fì wo jɛme gɛ, wo jo muh wu mumwaa kɛnɛ bafɛɛ bena bo kaasɛ bɛŋ gɛɛŋ fɛ wu le, fi le lɛ njɛmɛ wuchii kɛ̂me bamii bafɛɛ kɛnɛ batɛde bo bɛɛ jiŋ yi nsa wuyu.

Wu nɛ le wu gɛɛŋ wu faŋ ki wu yû fiɛɛ fì bo jɛme, wo jo wu mɛɛse wo gɛɛŋ fɛ kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ le. Wu faŋ ki wu yû mo fɛ kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ le, wo jo wu njɛ muh wù kee gɛ Nyo gɛ kɛnɛ njɛ muh wù koode ŋwa.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ le bɛŋ kaaŋ fɛkuu fɛnɛ, tu ba le ba kaaŋ wa fɛwe, fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ le bɛŋ faanyɛ fɛkuu fɛnɛ, tu ba le ba faanyɛ wa fɛwe.
Ŋka njɛme bɛŋ le lɛ, nɛ bamii bafɛɛ a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ nɛ bɛme yi fiɛɛ le fɛkuu fɛnɛ, bo lɛgɛ a buunɛ le, tu Chii wù le fɛwe lé wu gê fiɛɛ fiyu fɛ bo le.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ fɛ bamii bafɛɛ kɛnɛ batɛde le bo taashɛ fo a jee chaŋ le, tu nle a bo ntɛnɛɛ.”

content: Ŋgaŋ kune muh wu fioo wù koode gɛ yii gɛ
Bita mo wu kɛŋsɛ wu biih Jiso le lɛ, “Tada, le kiŋgane kimɛɛ kì mwa bwɛɛŋ gee mwɛɛ mù mbefe mɛne, nlɛɛshɛ gɛh lo? Taŋlo wu ge, gɛɛŋ bu kiŋgane kinsooshwi?”

content.text: “Gɛ taŋlo ndu wo le lɛ, taŋlo nyu gɛh kiŋgane kinsooshwi maa gɛ. Taŋlo nyu kiŋgane mbaŋbvusooshwi chikɛ bvusooshwi.
Nɛ fiɛɛ fì ba taŋlo ba fe bvunfoŋ bvù fɛwe bɛ Nfoŋ wumu wù gɛ̀ goone ki wu sêesɛ bɛ bamii be ba lɛme ba kwa we gɛ̀ bee chiaaŋ yiboo le.
No wu gɛ̀ kɛ ki wu tâade, bo to bɛ muh mu, ye fioo gɛ̀ bee bikɛɛ bi bige banchvuge yuufe.
No bi gɛ̀ ya wu ki wu lâŋɛ, Nfoŋ wɛɛ mo wu jɛme lɛ ba jo wu bɛ kwɛɛ mo booŋ mo mwɛɛ mwe munchii ba gesɛ ba to bɛ bige biyu ba laŋɛ fioo ye yu.
No Nfoŋ wɛɛ jɛme noo, muh wɛɛ gwe a wu jii wu ku chiaaŋ wu le, wu jɛmɛ lɛ, ‘Tada, koo gɛh yii bɛ mɛ, nlé ŋgê nlâŋɛ fiɛɛ fichii.’
Yii koo chiji kikwɛɛ wɛɛ wu chinɛ wu le wu daayɛ lo a fioo yɛɛ le.
Geenɛ, muh wɛɛ kibɛɛ bu wu doo wu gɛɛne, wu bu yi muh mu le wù bɛ bo gɛ̀ lɛne Nfoŋ wɛɛ le, wu gɛ̀ kɛme wu fioo kikɛɛ ki bige kimimia.
Wu mo wu jijɛ wu yi finse le wu jɛmɛ lɛ, ‘Laŋɛ fioo yo.’
Muh wu lɛme wɛɛ mo wu gwe tɛ a wu jii, wu lɛgɛ wu, wu jɛmɛ lɛ, ‘Koo gɛh yii bɛ mɛ, nlé ŋgê nlâŋɛ wo.’
Wu faŋ, wu jo wu wù gɛɛŋ wu faa wu yeh yi ncha le, lɛ wu nyûme yu gɛɛŋ bu sege wu laŋɛ fioo ye yɛɛ.
Bamii bamu ba bɛ bo gɛ̀ lɛne doo bo yɛŋ fiɛɛ fì kooshi le, fi lujɛ bo baaŋ. Bo mo bo gɛɛŋ bo sɛɛŋ fiɛɛ fichii fì kooshi Nfoŋ wɛɛ le.
Nfoŋ tɛɛŋ wu wu to, wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, ‘Wo le fiɛɛ fì achiji. Mbe ndaayɛ a yo fioo le yichii nje wo be wo ku chiaaŋ mɛne.
Gɛ be taŋlo tɛ wo koo yii fɛ muh wù bena bo lɛne le no mbe ŋkolɛ tɛ fɛ wo le gɛ?’
Nfoŋ wɛɛ toonyɛ shɛ́ŋ, wu nya wu lɛ ba fâa wu yeh yi ncha le, ba nyîɛge bɛ wu, gɛɛŋ bu sege wu lé wu gê wu laŋe fioo ye yɛɛ yichii.
Noo, le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no Chijaŋ wù le fɛwe lé wu gê bɛ muh wu mumwaa wu mumwaa bɛŋ le, nɛ muh baaŋ lɛɛshɛ gɛ bɛ fitele fie fichii fiɛɛ fì befe fì mwa bwee le wu ge fɛ wu le gɛ.”

footnotes.text: Gɛ baŋwa kege bamu ba ba gɛ̀ ya saŋ jɛ yi Nyo yo kɛme kinchiŋ kinɛ gɛ.
Kikɛɛ ki bige kinɛ le a jɛ́ Glek le njɛ badanale gwii.
